title: Characterisation of some multivalued harmonic functions on $\mathbb{R}^{n}$
summary: Using different approaches, Simon Donaldson and Dashen Yan recently constructed $\mathbb Z_2$-harmonic functions on $\mathbb R^3$ and on $\mathbb R^n$ for $n\geqslant 3$, respectively. Their examples have quadratic growth at infinity and $\mathcal{O}(r^{3/2})$ local growth near a smooth codimension-two branching set $Σ$. We show that these properties uniquely characterise such $\mathbb Z_2$-harmonic functions up to rigid motions of $\mathbb R^n$.
